name: work-cycle
description: Review existing open change requests, then run bounded ForgeSteward work cycles through mandatory stage subagents and merge eligible changes.

interface.shortDescription: Run complete work cycles through stage subagents.
interface.longDescription: Review the existing open change request queue first, then run up to ten complete issue work cycles by default. Each stage uses its own subagent. Eligible changes are merged and their source branches cleaned up; items still blocked after a third repair round are paused individually.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $forge-steward-work-cycle to run complete work cycles through subagents and merge eligible changes.
